body:
Releasing the UI surface (`app/renderer`). Three product commits, all pushed, all gates green
(pre-commit, integration 344 tests, exit engine + production build):

- `7f36124` — the answer fix. Uncommitted red work I inherited (see the claim: no claim, no event, no
  commit named it) carried forward rather than reverted. A `stopped` event that arrives inside an
  iteration dropped `partial_answer`; the rarer no-fan path read it into `evidence`, which everywhere
  else means the world's own words. `partialAnswer`/`answerBasis` on `Decision` now, captured on both
  paths, with four new renderer assertions covering each shape of ending and the field split.
- `af746cf` — a scrubber mark's colour came from `flags[0]`, which is `confirmed` on nearly every row,
  so every hunch drew as an ordinary green tick; the ledger's rows already had the right rule and the
  scrubber had a second, wrong copy of it (`leadFlag`, one place, four assertions). Plus the transport
  no longer says "rewound to 35" while offering a "jump to end" button that goes where the cursor
  already is.
- `dfa21a2` — the composition pass: empty panes as dashed plates instead of grey whispers in voids
  (including the files world's three empty cards, and Compare's plate that was hiding its own
  buttons); the map's footer as three divided zones instead of a five-label data dump, with the two
  duplicated numbers removed; three type sizes above body, where nothing had been larger than 13.5px;
  the toolbar's clipped world description replaced by the blocked reason, which previously lived only
  in a `title` attribute that Chromium never fires on a disabled control; the search tree's head no
  longer wrapping its button onto a ragged line; and a hairline in the file library where a run's
  identity ends and its numbers begin.

Verified in the running window, not from the diff: a second Electron instance on its own
`--remote-debugging-port` and `--user-data-dir`, so the supervisor's own window and sidecar were never
restarted. Screenshots at 1440, 1280, 1024 and 820; a maze run and a files run; the drawer, the
library, and a saved run reopened from it. That is what caught the coverage readouts wrapping to a
second ragged row and the clipping in Compare — both invisible in the source.

Full audit, including what I did not change and why: `reviews/2026-09-26-review.md`. One finding filed
rather than fixed, because it is reasoner behaviour and not the surface I claimed:
`B-2026-09-26-3` — the builtin files reasoner can settle `done` with a *verified* answer unrelated to
the question (any goal word matching a file's path is enough: a question mentioning "package" was
answered with `app/package-lock.json`'s first 200 characters, and the window paints it green).
